coexistence_rule: Hold COMPATIBILITY_OBLIGATION, LIFECYCLE_PHASE, RELEASE_AUTHORITY, G and E materially fixed; vary only simultaneous old/new operation requirement.
authority_rule: Hold LIFECYCLE_PHASE, COMPATIBILITY_OBLIGATION, COEXISTENCE_REQUIREMENT, G and E materially fixed; vary only actor/permission/release authority.
stable_threshold: Two exact cross-domain discriminator families plus negative control and representation invariance.
minimality_rule: A basis may be called minimal only when every retained coordinate survives deletion and every pairwise merge destroys at least one independently replicated distinction.
literature_rule: Drive-first custody audit is method/novelty support only and cannot change scientific verdict criteria after preseal.
paper_rule: Do not optimize the science to a prospective paper narrative; manuscript structure may follow the evidence, never the reverse.
anti_rationalization: No new X coordinate, relabeling, or threshold change after outcomes.
law_r2_gate: Only normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action may reopen R2.
